ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Mechanoid Crew
ModMetaData.author: Leo
ModMetaData.description:
Lets your colony mechanoids work the gravship launch ritual from Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapter 1.
Mechs can fill the pilot, copilot, gravtech researcher and gravtech engineer roles, and they can also join the launch as ordinary crew, counting towards the crew count bonus like a colonist would. Works with modded mechanoids too.
Mechs have no skills, so for the piloting, research and gravship stats they act as skill level 8 by default, and the normal skill curves of each stat decide how well they perform. Specialist mechs can be given their own levels through a small XML mod extension.
Only gravship launches are affected. Every other ritual behaves exactly as in vanilla.
Planned: support for the piloting ability that some modded mechs have, and for mech attributes in general.
Requires Biotech, Odyssey, Harmony and Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapter 1.
